# RoboSystems App v1.2.0

A major infrastructure release that migrates the shared core library from a git-subtree to a proper npm package (`@robosystems/core`), resulting in a cleaner, more maintainable codebase with ~27,000 lines removed. This release also includes important security hardening and several platform integration improvements.

## ✨ Features & Improvements

- **Graph-aware console:** The console now derives its configuration from the user's graph context, delivering a more relevant and streamlined experience when navigating between workspaces (#192)
- **Unified theme provider:** Removed redundant per-component theme props across the application in favor of a centralized theme provider, ensuring more consistent styling throughout the platform (#191)
- **Data Lake table discovery:** Table listing now uses `SHOW ALL TABLES`, surfacing previously hidden tables in the Data Lake explorer (#193)
- **SDK upgrade (`@robosystems/client` 0.4.0):** Integrated the latest client SDK with expanded content-ops capabilities, improving data operations across documents, backups, and library views (#194)

## 🔒 Security

- Validated SSO `returnUrl` parameters and closed a control-character bypass vulnerability
- Enforced S3 encryption-at-rest and TLS-only bucket access in CloudFormation templates
- Bound and sanitized API inputs across authentication flows
- Pinned all CI/CD GitHub Actions to commit SHAs to prevent supply-chain injection (#195)

## 🐛 Bug Fixes

- Fixed `returnUrl` control-character bypass that could redirect users to unintended destinations after login
- Resolved tag-release version splice issue in the release workflow
- Fixed ESM compatibility in `auth-core` by removing stale `require()` calls that could cause build failures

## ⚠️ Breaking Changes

- **Core library import paths have changed.** All 55 core components are now consumed from the `@robosystems/core` npm package with explicit `.js` import paths. Any custom imports referencing `src/lib/core/` must be updated to use the package specifier (#197, #198, #199).
- The `bin/sync-subtree.sh` script has been removed. Core library updates are now managed entirely through npm versioning (`@robosystems/core@^0.3.0`).

## 🔧 Technical Changes

- **Git-subtree → npm package migration:** Replaced the `src/lib/core/` subtree with `@robosystems/core` installed from the npm registry, removing ~27,500 lines of vendored code and simplifying the dependency graph (#197)
- **Design-sync retargeted:** The `compile-css` pipeline and design-sync tooling now resolve component paths from the installed npm package rather than the local subtree (#198, #199)
- **CI hardening:** Build, deploy, staging, and production workflows updated with SHA-pinned actions and tightened permissions
- **197 components and 50 pages touched** as part of the theme and import-path migration — no visual regressions expected
